camera_film: ARRI Alexa 35 / Alexa Mini LF look: ARRI color science (LogC to Rec709), natural skin tones, smooth highlight roll-off, anamorphic lenses, fine 35mm grain, soft organic rendering
grade_stock: bleach-bypass look, desaturated, harsh contrast, gritty metallic texture

color_balance.accent: ember amber (only warm color — embers, candles, the firebird's glow)

lighting_base: low-key chiaroscuro, single hard key, NEGATIVE FILL on the shadow side (black flags, no bounce), deep controlled shadows with readable crushed blacks, restrained highlights; volumetric shafts with ash and dust
atmosphere: fine ash and dust particles always drifting in the air, indoors and outdoors
art_direction: production-rich FG/MG/BG layering, no dead space; scorched white stone, worn linen and leather; no glossy fantasy armor

scene_overrides.S01: flat ash-grey dawn light, vast negative space
scene_overrides.S04: motivated candle practical as key; Rembrandt lighting on close-ups
scene_overrides.S05: near-monochrome desaturated memory flash, hard flat light, heavier grain
scene_overrides.S06: hard rim backlight from the doorway, figures as silhouettes; cold side light on Riven close-ups
scene_overrides.S07: hard light, flying sparks are the only warm points
scene_overrides.S08: total stillness turns to warm amber glow from the ember (liberated color code) on palm and faces; the rest stays ash grey
scene_overrides.S09: flat ash-grey daylight, wind, vast negative space

depth_of_field: always shallow: fast prime f/1.4-f/2 or telephoto, subject razor sharp, background melting into bokeh; foreground occlusion layer out of focus

shot_grammar.rule: every scene mixes several shot types; eye-level or flat frontal/plain side composition is forbidden
